name: Cipher Card
description: A card covered in hidden characters that show, and keep shifting, only where the pointer shines, around a round seal with a short word.

props.name: text
props.description: The word on the round seal in the centre, and the card's accessible name. No seal is drawn when it is empty.

props.name: charset
props.description: Characters the hidden field is made of.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the revealed area around the pointer, in pixels.

props.name: colors
props.description: The revealed characters run from the first colour at the pointer to the second at the edge of the light.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Set its size here. The card is focusable; keyboard focus reveals the field around the centre.
